name: bubble-field
title: Bubble Field
description: Two-axis scatter with optional log10 scales, square-root bubble sizing, categorical color, decade gridlines, and computed legend counts.

meta.question: How is the pool scattered across two axes?
meta.whenToUse: Showing how a pool of entities spreads across two quantitative axes with size and category as secondary encodings.
meta.antiUse: Few points with runs per entity and an efficiency story — use frontier-board; exact value reading — use a table.
